name: tavolio
description: Local-first tabular prediction for spreadsheets. Spreadsheet host is a shell; the tabular engine is the product.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@tavolio/table && npm run build --workspace=@tavolio/preprocessing && npm run build --workspace=@tavolio/runtime && npm run build --workspace=@tavolio/models && npm run build --workspace=@tavolio/prediction && npm run build --workspace=tests-integration && npm run typecheck --workspace=@tavolio/ui && npm run build --workspace=google-sheets
